name: Seamless.AI
description: Seamless.AI is a B2B sales intelligence platform for finding and enriching company and professional contact data. Revenue teams use it to research accounts, build prospecting workflows and support outbound sales operations.
agentUseSummary: Connect a dedicated customer-owned Seamless.AI API key with Public API v1 access. Agents can search at most five companies by one explicit name or domain and receive reduced company-only data; contact data, research, outreach, lists, campaigns, provider-hosted MCP, bulk and raw access remain blocked.

credentialRequirements.name: SEAMLESS_API_KEY
credentialRequirements.label: Seamless.AI API key
credentialRequirements.helpText: Use a dedicated key with Public API v1 access. Relay encrypts it and permits only one fixed bounded company-search endpoint.

capabilities.label: Search companies
capabilities.description: Search by one explicit company name or root domain, capped at five reduced company-only results without starting research.

allowed.label: Search companies
allowed.description: Search for at most five companies by one explicit name or root domain and return reduced company-only data without starting research or exposing contacts.

blocked.label: Block people and contact data
blocked.description: Contact search, personal and professional contact details, profiles, saved contacts and people enrichment are unavailable.

blocked.label: Block research and outreach
blocked.description: Credit-consuming research, lists, exports, CRM sync, email, calls, tasks, templates, campaigns, saved searches and outreach are unavailable.

blocked.label: Block MCP, administration, bulk, and raw access
blocked.description: Provider-hosted MCP, resources, API-key management, arbitrary endpoints, webhooks, bulk input, retries, pagination, browser sessions and unrestricted tools are unavailable.

approvalProfiles.label: Safe
approvalProfiles.description: One bounded company-only search runs automatically. People data, research, outreach, campaigns, MCP, administration, bulk and raw access remain blocked.

approvalProfiles.label: Dangerously skip permissions
approvalProfiles.description: The same bounded company-only search runs without approval; the broad API key never expands Relay's fixed endpoint, input or output contract.

runtimeSupport.description: Relay mounts exactly one bounded company-only search while Railway alone holds the customer API key.
Relay mounts exactly one bounded company-only search while Railway alone holds the customer API key.

providerSetup.blocker: A customer Seamless.AI account, a dedicated key with Public API v1 access, current API-terms/privacy review, a lawful B2B purpose, Railway staging entry, live schema validation and credential-lifecycle testing remain for a separate authorized provider task.
providerSetup.nextAction: An authorized provider task must confirm the customer's permitted B2B purpose and privacy obligations, create a dedicated Public API v1 key in Seamless.AI, store it in Railway staging, and validate only the fixed company-search endpoint with one name or domain, the five-result cap, reduced company-only output, no contact fields, no research job or credit consumption, no pagination/retry/MCP, rate-limit handling, encrypted-copy deletion, provider-side key rotation and post-rotation denial.

evidence.supports: Seamless.AI documents its REST API for company/contact search and research, API-key or OAuth authentication, polling/webhooks and a separate provider-hosted MCP surface.
Seamless.AI documents customer-created API keys in Public API settings, the Token header and the fixed production origin https://api.seamless.ai/api/client/v1.

Seamless.AI documents POST /search/companies, explicit company-name/domain filters, match modes, pagination and the response schema. Relay narrows this to one filter, at most five first-page results and reduced company-only fields.

Seamless.AI documents organization-level rate limits, quota and credit headers, 429 handling, and that research endpoints consume credits while search does not start research jobs. Relay never retries or starts research.

Seamless.AI documents a broad OAuth 2.1 or API-key MCP server with MCP scope. Relay blocks the entire provider-hosted MCP surface rather than mounting its contact, research, campaign or outreach tools.

Seamless.AI's current public API terms authorize compliant developer applications but prohibit substitutes, unauthorized harvesting/caching, spam, bulk scraping, resale and excessive use, and impose consent, privacy, retention and security duties.

Seamless.AI's current privacy policy describes professional contact and company data, linked accounts, marketing uses, rights requests, security, retention and international transfers. Relay's V1 returns no individual contact data.
